scope: Final distribution source controls and safety to proceed with isolated unsigned installer smoke, not public-release acceptance
independence: Reviewer did not implement distribution production code and performed only lightweight source reads during this final review.
executionPrerequisites: Current isolated unsigned NSIS candidate compiles successfully.
Current verify:artifact and release:metadata gates pass.
Use the guarded run-installer-smoke.mjs unchanged; it refuses any existing test registration and verifies candidate identity/hash/actual unsigned signature before launch.

resolvedFinding.summary: Job-wide signing credentials removed; certificate values only on two signing build steps

confirmedControls: Isolated appId/GUID/executable/default root/output/updater cache/userData; test shortcuts and associations disabled.
Init, VerifyInstDir and final hidden NSIS Section guard final target before prior uninstall and extraction.
Unrelated nonempty first-install negative fixture; unsafe legacy marker and per-machine upgrade rejection.
Root/ancestor/whitelist reparse checks, exact owned-file removal, nonrecursive empty-directory removal, explicit --delete-app-data rejection.
Private keys absent from npm ci, smoke, signature/hash metadata and upload environments.
Formal owner/license/source/manual-QA evidence hashes and actual installer/application/NativeHost signature/publisher/timestamp required.

remainingRisks.summary: Interrupted replacement after safe uninstall and before marker recreation can leave a partial nonempty target requiring reviewed manual recovery; upgrade is not transactional.
Preflight and path ownership are not proof against same-user malicious post-check mutations or users replacing nominal application-owned files.
